title: Best Skipping Ropes in India (2026)
summary: Three Domyos skipping ropes from Decathlon: basic, speed and weighted. Not hand-tested; based on maker and shop pages.
description: Helps first-time and regular skippers in India pick between a basic, a speed and a weighted Domyos rope. Based on maker and shop pages.
lead: Which skipping rope should you buy in India? We have not hand-tested any rope. This short list comes from maker pages and shop listings. All three picks are Domyos ropes from Decathlon. One is a basic rope for first-timers. One is a speed rope for fast skipping. One is a weighted rope for a heavier workout. It is a short list, not a ranking of every rope.

picks.name: Domyos Skipping Rope JR100
picks.label: For first-timers
picks.verdict: A plain, simple rope for learning to skip at lower speeds. It has a high buyer score on the Decathlon India page.
paragraphs: This is Decathlon's basic rope. The Decathlon Qatar page for the same rope is called Skipping Rope 100. It describes a PVC rope about 3 m long with a height-adjustment system and textured polypropylene handles. There are no ball bearings. The maker says it is for learning to skip at lower speeds and for indoor use on non-abrasive floors.

Know this before you buy. The Decathlon India page shows no specs. The details above come from the Qatar page, matched by product ID and name. We could not confirm the exact rope length, handle details, weight or box contents on the India page. We also could not confirm that it is sold on Amazon.in or Flipkart, so check the exact listing or visit a store. Decathlon India shows about 4.7 out of 5 from about 7,000 reviews. We could not see any review text, so we do not know what buyers like or dislike.
good: Simple design with no moving parts
The maker calls it a beginner rope, with adjustable length
Decathlon India shows about 4.7 out of 5 from about 7,000 reviews, the most of the three
The page shows a 2-year warranty and 30-day returns, though the terms were not shown
not_good: No bearings, so it will not spin as freely as a speed rope
The maker says it is meant for indoor, non-abrasive floors
The India page lists no specs, so check length and handle details before buying

picks.name: Domyos Cross-Training Speed Skipping Rope - Black
picks.label: For fast skipping
cells: Indoor or on a mat; avoid rough floors
picks.verdict: A light speed rope with a bearing, made for fast skipping and double unders. It suits people who already know the basics.
paragraphs: This is a speed rope. The Decathlon Malta page for the same product ID says the cable is half steel and half TPU (a type of plastic). It is 2.5 mm thick and 3.4 m long, and the whole rope weighs 130 g. A ball bearing sits in the rotating head. The long polypropylene handles are meant to help the rope turn faster. You adjust the length by tightening two screws with the supplied tool. The maker says it suits beginners and experienced users alike.

What to know. The maker advises indoor use. It says to avoid outdoor tarmac and rough or abrasive surfaces. Decathlon India shows about 4.6 out of 5 from 749 reviews, while Malta shows 4.5, so the score may change. We could not see any review text. The India page lists no specs, so the details above come from the Malta page. We could not confirm the bearing grade, the handle length, or whether the spare rope or plastic sheath is sold in India. We also could not confirm that it is sold on Amazon.in or Flipkart.
good: Built for fast skipping, with a bearing and long handles, says the maker
Thin, light cable that the maker presents as suited to quick turning
A black replacement rope is listed as a spare part on the Malta page, though India availability is not confirmed
The India page shows a 2-year warranty and 30-day returns
not_good: The maker says to avoid rough surfaces and outdoor tarmac, so use it indoors or on a mat
Made for speed, so a basic rope may be a simpler start for a total beginner
Changing the length needs a tool and screws, not a simple tie-off

picks.name: Domyos Weighted Skipping Rope 700
picks.label: For a heavier workout
cells: Weighted rope, 2 x 90 g in handles
picks.verdict: A rope with removable handle weights for people who already skip and want more resistance. It has fewer buyer reviews to go on.
paragraphs: This rope has thick 28 mm handles that hold two removable 90 g weights. These details come from the Decathlon Qatar page for the same product ID, because the India page shows no specs. The Qatar page lists a 3 m rope with a height-adjustment system and ABEC5 ball bearings. You can take the weights out, so you can start without them.

What to know. The Qatar page contradicts itself on the rope material. One part says PVC and NBR. Another says 100% TPU. So the material is unclear. The page says the rope is designed for smooth surfaces. If you are new to skipping, try it without the weights first. Decathlon India shows about 4.5 out of 5 from 233 reviews. We could not see any review text. We could not confirm the specs on the India page, the total weight with and without the weights, or the box contents. A search found no Amazon.in or Flipkart listing.
good: Removable weights let you skip with or without the extra handle weight
The Qatar page lists ball bearings and thick 28 mm handles
The India page shows a 2-year warranty and 30-day returns
About 4.5 out of 5 on the India page, though from fewer buyers than the other two ropes
not_good: The material information on the Qatar page is inconsistent, and the specs come from a non-India page
Far fewer reviews than the other two ropes, so there is less buyer evidence
The Qatar page says it is for smooth surfaces

choose.heading: Start with your skill level
choose.text: The maker of the Domyos JR100 says it is a basic rope with no bearings, made for learning at lower speeds. If you are new to skipping, a basic rope like this is a simple place to start.

choose.heading: Know what a speed rope is
choose.text: A speed rope has a bearing in the handle. A bearing is a small part that lets the rope spin freely. It also has a thin cable. The Domyos speed rope has a 2.5 mm cable and weighs 130 g in all. The maker says it is made for fast skipping.

choose.heading: Check the surface
choose.text: The Domyos pages for all three ropes advise indoor use or smooth, non-abrasive floors. The speed rope page also says to avoid outdoor tarmac and rough surfaces. A mat or smooth indoor floor is the safe choice.

choose.heading: Check how the length adjusts
choose.text: These ropes are about 3 m to 3.4 m long and adjustable. The Malta page says the handles should reach your armpits when sized. The speed rope needs a tool and screws to adjust, so keep that tool safe.

choose.heading: Think about weighted handles
choose.text: Weighted ropes add resistance. On the Domyos 700 the weight is two removable 90 g pieces in the handles. So you can start without them.

choose.heading: Look at reviews and spare parts
choose.text: Look at the number of reviews as well as the score. Decathlon India shows about 7,000 reviews for the basic rope, 749 for the speed rope and 233 for the weighted one. Also check whether a spare rope exists. The India pages we opened show no specs, so those details come from Decathlon sites in Qatar and Malta. Check length, weight, bearing type and box contents on the exact India page or in store.

faq.q: Which skipping rope is best for a beginner?
faq.a: The Domyos JR100 is the one the maker describes as made for learning to skip. It has no bearings and is meant for lower speeds. The maker of the speed rope also says it suits beginners. But it is built for fast skipping, so the basic rope may be the simpler start.

faq.q: Do I need a rope with bearings?
faq.a: Not to start. The maker of the basic rope says it is for learning, and it has no bearings. A bearing helps the handle spin freely. The speed rope has one. Its maker says it is made for fast skipping and double unders.

faq.q: Can I skip outdoors with these ropes?
faq.a: The maker advises indoor use or smooth, non-abrasive floors for all three. For the speed rope, the Malta page says to avoid outdoor tarmac and rough surfaces. It also mentions a plastic sheath for outdoor use. We could not confirm that it is sold in India.

faq.q: Are these ropes available on Amazon.in or Flipkart?
faq.a: We could not confirm that. All three are listed on Decathlon India, and that is the only shop we can point to. The India pages did not show a clear stock status when we opened them. Stock can change by store and pincode, so check the page before you plan to buy.
